Early adopters of Mac version of Meta Muse - beware! 

Zero day flaw if properly aligned can  hijack tokens and exfiltrate user data. If enabled this could "turn Muse into the ultimate backdoor."

The some what good news - certain features need to be enabled, and certain integrations established before the bug can be invoked. The exploit cannot break into a Mac on its own. 

It works by changing a hidden setting so that when the user taps the microphone and dictates a prompt, the words go to the attacker instead of Meta. https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/one-hidden-meta-muse-setting-could-let.html  #AI #MUSE #Meta #ZeroDay #Security #CyberSecurity #MAC #BackDoor #AIAgent #AgenticAI  #Software  #Hacker #AISecurity  #AIAssistant
